name: archgate
description: Architecture map + plan gate: the AI maps modules, declares a scope, you approve it, and edits outside that scope are blocked and observed.

mode.title: Trigger mode
mode.description: on-demand: the gate holds only once a plan is submitted. auto: every code edit needs an approved plan.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.description: block: refuse edits outside the approved scope. warn: allow them but flag them. off: observe only.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane, status line and report.
